The same AI model can run differently across chips. Kaoutar El Maghraoui explains how GPUs, TPUs, and AI accelerators store and move KV cache during LLM inference. Learn why memory architecture and data movement can shape AI performance.

 00:00 – Understand Why LLMs Need a KV Cache
 00:46 – See How KV Cache Reuses Keys and Values
 01:39 – Balance KV Cache Capacity and Fast Memory
 02:41 – Follow KV Cache Through GPU Memory
 04:41 – Compare TPU Memory and Compiler Orchestration
 06:44 – Explore Dataflow Accelerator Memory
 08:34 – Compare How AI Accelerators Move KV Cache
 09:05 – Connect KV Cache Movement to LLM Performance
